name: Listing, Dropped Through
tagline: The evening listing with its tube in Coming up: a short lit stem drops from the tube onto NOW, rows lie on page ground with the time in its own column, and one faint thread runs on to To do.
concept: Evening Listing's programme page, with its lit gesture made honest. The Next up tube is now the featured programme at the head of Coming up. From its power lamp a 28px white-cored stem drops straight onto a breathing NOW lamp, and one rail x carries on from there: lit to the next plan, tapering to sage, then a faint dashed thread that crosses the setup strip down to To do's NOW, which lights again. Under that one lit thread the page is calm. Every list sits on page ground under hairlines and reads like a printed evening TV listing, set in the IBM Plex superfamily.
companions: Steel (#84a0c4 accent, with the #6b8396 reverse and its #9cc4dc cap) marks "here": latched segmented keys, the current settings part, the latched kind in the index and in the form, the 12% steel hover wash, the "usually Plans" tags, and now the tube's weekend shading and grid. Sage (--lit #86d9a6) takes the green's place where it was not the signature: the trace's non-next pulses at 60%, its axis and ticks, the tapering rail after NOW, the hover's 2px edge and setup step one. Bone (--ink-2) is the setup strip's 3px bar. Amber (#ffb850) means late only, shown as a ▲ plus Plex Sans words. The kind hues replace the old slate fills: they colour the icons on 1px line-2 squares, the kind words, the Ideas index and now the form's kind index. Plans-cyan carries the month chips' 2px edges. Bright #6dff9c is kept for the mark, Send and the primary buttons, focus, "list.", the tube's words and the Next pulse, the stem, the NOW lamps, the Next ring, the live lamps, the "next in 2 days" dot and the meter needle.
decisions: Built on x14a-listing-cross's files. The sheet is today's themed stylesheet plus palette.css, built by variants/x14b-listing-cross/build.py. This revision is a 'Revision 4' block appended to palette.css, plus small template edits (_ui.html trace, tasks.html).

One head-column rule on every band: the h2, the figure 0.5rem under it, then the links. A page's list head with no h2 (Ideas, To do) starts its figure level with the band's first line. All the measured per-band margins are overridden. On Coming up the band head now spans the head column beside the tube ('head tube' / 'head now' / 'head rows'), so '4 PLANS' and 'All plans' fill the hole that was beside the tube.

The tube carries one green pulse. Only the Next pulse, its 'Sun 4 · next' label, NOW and the power lamp stay #6dff9c. The other pulses are sage at 60% with their halos almost off, the day numerals are dim sage, weekends are shaded in steel at 10%, and the grid is a steel dotted line. The title is not underlined at rest (it underlines on hover and focus). The dead grille strip at the bottom right is gone. The text column is minmax(15rem,max-content) with the trace centred in the rest, which closes the dark glass between the words and the trace.

Page heads: the 28px section glyph sits in the flow before the h1, both in the body column, with a 0.55rem gap. It reads as one unit, like the band h2s with their inline icons. html{scrollbar-gutter:stable} keeps every page on the same x whether or not it scrolls, which removes the Settings overview's 7px shift.

To do boxes are open: transparent, with a 1.5px --edge border, steel and the wash on hover, and the brand ring on focus. The rail above NOW is drawn in --line-2, so only the NOW segment and lamp light. The duplicate '+ Add something to do' is gone from the To do page's head column, which now holds only '4 OPEN' and '3 late →'.

The new-idea form's kinds now follow Ideas' index: 44px unfilled lines, a 16px icon in its kind's hue, Plex Sans, and the chosen kind in steel reverse with a 1px cap edge. The square bullet before 'Kind' is gone.

The thread crosses the setup strip as a 1px dashed notch at the rail's x, drawn as a background-image on the strip itself. The strip's words now start past the rail, as a band body does: the h2 takes the head column and '3 left' starts at body-x + rail-x + 16px. So the thread reads as one rail from the tube to To do's NOW.
Plans: today's cell lost its green outline and inset glow, so the steel reverse number alone marks it.

Phone: the bar's lit cursor block is hidden and the brand shows its full word. The ask textarea is 4.25rem. The starters are full-width 48px keys, with the words over a 0.75rem steel 'usually ...' line, so none truncates. The title is set at 2rem and the tube title at 1.375rem, so 'Oaks Park roller rink' sits on one line. The Next up title now sits at about y=727 of 844, above the tab bar.
title: "Put it on / Vera's *list.*" (one line on desktop, broken after "on" on the phone). It says FamilyDB's job: anything the family hands over (a plan, an idea, a reminder) goes onto the list Vera keeps and acts on. "list." is the word the listing below then shows.
measures: Full render: 0 hard checks failed. One guideline missed: words differ from today's (worst is Home at 34.6%, from the listing anatomy, the starter tags and the title). ink_on_bg 12.49, brand_on_bg 15.18, brand_neon_vs_today 1.0. Green share of colour: Home 81.3% (entropy 0.48), Ideas 45.8% (0.39), Chat 66.1% (0.42), Status 42.1% (0.33). Home's green is now mostly the motif itself: the Send button and the box's glow (about 9k px in one 100px band), and the tube's lit words. Sage pulses still count as green under the metric's hue window (85-175), so the brief's sage swap barely moves the number. 0 targets under 44px on every page in health.json. Smallest text 11.97px (a code line on General). No sideways scroll.
strengths: The line's signature is honest and whole. A 28px straight stem drops from the tube's power lamp onto a breathing NOW lamp, the rail is lit to the Next ring and then tapers, and a faint dashed thread now visibly crosses the setup strip to To do's NOW at the same x.
One head-column rule on every band and page (h2, figure 0.5rem under, links). Coming up's head column now fills the space beside the tube instead of leaving a hole.
The listing rows are the best typesetting on the page: a Plex Sans Condensed 300 day numeral, mono OCT over SUN, the time in its own column, a Plex Sans 600 title, a dotted leader and how far off.

No slate left in the lists, the form or the checkboxes. Colour is replaced, not removed: kind hues in the icons, the indices and the words; steel for 'here'; sage for the quieter light; amber only for late.
The tube now has one green pulse, the next one. The rest of the trace is sage and steel, so the light falls where attention belongs.
Every page head reads as a unit at the same x, and with a stable scrollbar gutter that holds whether or not the page scrolls.
Phone: the full wordmark, 48px one-idea starter keys and the Next up title above the tab bar. 0 small targets everywhere.
weaknesses: Home is still about 81% green by the metric. Most of it is the motif (Send, the box's glow, the tube's words), and the sage that replaced bright green falls inside the metric's green window, so this fix shows on the page but not in the number.
The tube's trace is limited by its height, so about 70px of empty glass is left at its right end on a 1280 screen.
On the phone the Next up title sits only about 45px above the tab bar. Its date line and the countdown are below the fold.
The steel reverse stays at #6b8396, not the brief's #5f7689. The darker one would put the dark ink on it at about 4.0:1, under 4.5.
On the new-idea form, 'Kind' in the head column is a band-weight heading while the body's field labels are small Plex Sans, which is a slightly uneven pair at the top of the form.
The listing's two-column anatomy on the phone (time at the right, 'in 2 days' under the title) was not re-examined this round beyond the shot.
revisions: Head-column figures: one rule for every band (h2, then the figure 0.5rem under it, then the links). The measured margins are overridden with !important. Coming up's head spans the head column beside the tube. Ideas and To do now use 'head tools' / 'head body', so '12 IDEAS' and '4 OPEN' sit level with the search field instead of floating mid-list.

Tube: non-next pulses in sage at 60% with their halos nearly off, weekends shaded steel at 10%, steel grid, sage axis and ticks. The title is not underlined at rest. The dead grille strip at the bottom right is gone (.next-up::before content:none). The text column auto-sizes (minmax(15rem,max-content)) and the trace is centred with preserveAspectRatio, closing the gap between the words and the trace.

Page heads: the 28px icon is in the flow before the title, in the body column, on every page (it used to hang in the gutter). Added scrollbar-gutter:stable so the Settings overview no longer sits 7px to the right; that shift came from the missing scrollbar.
New-idea form: the kind keys are rebuilt as Ideas' index (unfilled 44px lines, a 16px hued icon, and the chosen kind in steel reverse with a cap edge). The violet square bullet before 'Kind' is gone.

To do (Home and its own page): the checkboxes are transparent with a 1.5px border, steel on hover and the brand ring on focus. The past rail is in --line-2. The duplicate '+ Add something to do' is deleted from the To do page's head column (tasks.html); the body's disclosure still offers it.

Phone: the lit cursor block in the bar is hidden so 'FamilyDB' shows whole. The textarea is 4.25rem. The starters are full-width 48px keys with 'usually X' under the words at 0.75rem. The tube title is at 1.375rem on one line. Gaps are tightened. The NEXT UP title moved from about 760 (wrapping, under the tab bar) to about 727.
Thread: it now crosses the setup strip as a dashed 1px notch drawn on the strip's own background, and the strip's words start past the rail.

Plans: removed the green outline and inset glow on today's cell. The '5 PLANS THIS MONTH' figure was already on the month name's baseline within a couple of pixels after the head rule, so it was left there.

Declined: drawing the To do checkbox border in --line-2 as asked. On the ground it would be about 1.5:1, below 3:1 for a control's edge, so I used --edge (#66727a) and kept --line-2 for the past rail only.
Declined: the steel reverse at #5f7689. With the dark ink on it, the latched keys' words would drop to about 4.0:1, so the reverse stays at #6b8396.
Declined: widening the tube's text block to a fixed 42%. That fixed share was what left the dark glass between the words and the trace, so the column now fits its content instead.
crit: Head-column figures float, and float differently on every band. On Home, 'Coming up' sits level with the tube's top but '4 PLANS' drops about 230px down to the first row, leaving a dark hole beside the tube. On Home's To do, the big '4' butts straight under the 'To do' h2 with no gap. On the To do page, '4 OPEN' hangs at y≈370, mid-list. On Ideas, '12 IDEAS' starts at y≈620, under 300px of empty head column. Pick one rule for every .band-head: h2, then the figure 0.5rem under it (as Lately added already does), then its links. Drop the measured margins and keep the baseline trick only if it is real CSS on every band. On Coming up, the figure then sits beside the tube and fills the hole, which is also what the line's own weakness list asks for.

Home is still about 84% green, and most of it is the tube's trace. Keep #6dff9c only on the Next pulse ('Sun 4 · next'), the NOW tick and the power lamp. Draw the other pulses in --lit sage at about 60%, and shade the weekends with a steel tint (color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent)) instead of green fill. Name sage and steel as the hues that take green's place, so colour is replaced, not removed.

Take the underline off the tube's VT323 title 'Oaks Park roller rink' at rest (.next-tube a: text-decoration none, underline on hover and focus only). Row titles underlined at rest are a recorded fault. Remove the leftover grille strip at the tube's bottom right too: the power lamp now lives bottom-left, and the strip reads as a second, dead port. Close the dark glass between the words and the trace: widen the text block to about 42% or start the trace at the left of its 62%, and give 'NOW' and the '4' under the first pulse at least 8px between them.

Page heads on Ideas, To do, Plans, Status, General, the form and the Settings overview: the 28px icon hangs in the 2rem column gap (x≈215-238), in neither the head column nor at the title's x, and the head column above the first rule is empty. On the Settings overview the title also starts at x=258 instead of 250 like every other page. Set .page-head on the band grid: icon and h1 inline in the body column, with the icon in the flow before the title and a 0.5rem gap, so the title still starts at the body x. Or start the whole head at the head column's left edge. Either way, use the same x on every page.

The new-idea form still has slate. The kind keys in its head column are filled grey blocks, the one place the 'slate goes' rule was not carried through, and '■ Kind' wears a violet square bullet. Rebuild them as Ideas' kind index: 44px lines, a 16px icon in its hue, the name, no fill, and the chosen kind in steel reverse #5f7689 with a #a9c4d8 edge. Drop the square bullet before 'Kind'.

To do, on Home and on its own page: the checkboxes are filled slate squares that read as disabled, and the rail between them is a flat grey line with no lit run before NOW. Make the box transparent with a 1.5px --line-2 border (steel on hover, the brand ring on focus), and draw the past rail above NOW in --line-2 so only the NOW tick lights. Delete the duplicate '+ Add something to do' in the To do page's head column, since the body disclosure already offers it. Under the figure, keep '3 late →' and nothing else.

Phone (home-phone): the NEXT UP title lands at about 760 of 844, and the bar truncates the brand to 'Family…'. Lift the tube: cut the textarea's empty height on the phone (min-height about 5.5rem, not about 8), and keep each starter key to one line at 48px. Set 'usually Plans' under the words at 0.75rem, or shorten the first starter so it does not wrap to 96px. Give the brand its full word by dropping the bar's lit cursor block on the phone or letting the right-hand icons shrink.

The dashed thread from Coming up to To do's NOW is hidden by the opaque setup strip and shows only in the gaps, so it reads as a stray dotted line, not one rail. Either let it cross the strip as a 1px --line-2 notch at --rail-x, drawn on the strip's own background so it reads through, or end the thread at Coming up's foot with a small sage terminal tick. On Plans the month grid has no rail. That is fine, but set '5 PLANS THIS MONTH' on the baseline of 'October 2026', not 30px above it, and drop the green 1px outline on today's cell, since the steel reverse number already marks it.

firstDraft.concept: Evening Listing's programme page is kept, and its lit gesture is made honest. Next up's tube now heads Coming up as the featured programme. From the tube's power lamp, a straight 28px white-cored stem drops onto a breathing NOW lamp. From there one rail x runs down the listing, lit to the next plan and then tapering. It carries on as a faint dashed thread behind the setup strip to To do's NOW, which lights again. Under the light the page is calm: every list sits on page ground under hairlines and reads like a printed evening TV listing (day numeral, month over weekday, time in its own column, title, leader, how far off), set in the full Plex superfamily.
